comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Two notes.

1. A decorative item recipe from Lost Memories: Chapter 2 will require x50 of this trade good. Being that it also requires x5 of the elusive Platinum Ore as well, it's probably good that said item is just decorative and not essential to gameplay.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Update/19Colossus

2. User names in white like Igor's (06-02-2012) date back to a point in this DB's history when anonymous comments allowed. Due to abuse, this feature was disabled, and with good reason -- Igor's comment is demonstrably false. Neither JP wiki tables nor charted land crops data shows this good as being obtained from any landing points.
